description: Solar Potential is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bristol City Council. This dataset comprises polygon data which shows an assessment of building roofs within the Bristol area for suitability for the installation of solar panels. This provides a general indication of the suitability and an estimate of the amount of power that could be generated from the roof area. Coverage: Bristol City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Bristol City Council. Its tags are Energy and fuel, Energy resources. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
